title: libddb build file
description: DDBResolveBuildFile (new in 2.0): a file inside an artifact of a build. A host that reads a plain string (the first 2.0 builds) reads the path from the object when it is one.

path.description: The absolute path (UTF-8) of the file

mediaType.description: The media type of the artifact when the file is the one a client opens (a file artifact, the index of a directory artifact); absent for any other file of a directory artifact (its tiles)

version.description: The version of the artifact the file belongs to, as DDBGetBuildArtifacts lists it now (the same for every file of a directory artifact); absent only when it cannot be read
